description: This file defines the PriceBooks class for managing price book entities in the vtiger CRM system, including methods for updating prices, retrieving related products and services, and generating report queries.

classes.name: PriceBooks
classes.description: Represents the PriceBooks entity with methods for managing price books, related products/services, and report queries.

methods.name: PriceBooks
methods.description: Constructor initializing logger, database connection, and column fields.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Updates list prices when the module is saved.

methods.name: updateListPrices
methods.description: Recalculates and updates list prices for products when currency changes.

methods.name: get_pricebook_products
methods.description: Retrieves products related to a specific price book.

methods.name: get_pricebook_services
methods.description: Retrieves services related to a specific price book.

methods.name: get_pricebook_noproduct
methods.description: Checks if a product is associated with any price book.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Generates the primary SQL query part for reports.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Generates the secondary SQL query part for related modules in reports.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for related modules like Products and Services.
